correctness.rationale: A flip with two or three discordant incident edges reduces the cut by one or three. While the spin configuration is unchanged, the waiting time for a genuine flip is an exponential race among the enabled vertices, uniform over them because their rates are identical. The cut descent and finite waiting times prove almost-sure absorption and the proposed recurrence. Every mixed absorber has monochromatic minimum degree at least two in both colors. Girth five forces two complementary induced five-cycles; exact enumeration verifies twelve such assignments, one S5 orbit. Independently I built KG(5,2) and performed forward probability transport, not the supplied backward recursion: starting with one unit of mass at each state of size k, visit the states in descending cut and distribute mass equally to enabled successors. This verifies all eleven unnormalized Bernoulli coefficients (nonzero at k=3,4,5,6,7 with values 88/9,8242/189,12788/189,8242/189,88/9), equal mass at the twelve mixed sinks at each k, and Q(1/2)=4121/24192. Both proposed polynomials in p have degree at most ten and agree at eleven distinct exact rational points. I also verified the frozen CSV entries for all 18 symmetry classes and their exact absorption values from the representative states. The endpoints are consensual and the formula is strictly increasing in p(1−p), giving the unique maximizer at one half. This does not model a parallel update or random fields.
residual_risks: Unequal clock rates preserve descent but not the uniform choice of enabled vertex. The law is not asserted in that regime.

equivalent_formulations.reasoning: Synchronous fixed points coincide with the asynchronous sinks, but synchronous basins and two-cycles are not equivalent to the clock-driven absorption law. With only two colors present, the three-color transition graph restricts exactly to the binary one: a missing color has zero agreeing neighbors, so introduction cannot strictly improve energy, and at most one rate-one move per vertex remains. This is dynamics equivalence on the closed subspace, not equality of the laws evaluated in the two findings.

value.rationale: The Bernoulli trapping law measures kinetic accessibility rather than the mere number of locally stable patterns. It gives an exact bias-dependent benchmark, including suppression to third order at small seed probability and the exact extremum at an unbiased quench, for a canonical non-bipartite cubic graph. The finite coefficient profile is useful independently of a larger-family solution and is not supplied by the standard fixed-point census or the reported three-color aggregates.
